The fallback recover_via names 'response_format:legacy' as the recovery instrument, but no schema on kala_story_get (or any tested tool) exposes a 'response_format' parameter — this is a second, non-'unknown_tool' instance of the same 'placeholder recover_via that names nothing callable' defect class. Mechanism: platform-mcp/src/lib/response_budget.ts:402-410 (the 1-entry-still-too-big fallback inside finalizeMcpBudget) and :292 (an earlier identical fallback inside applyResponseBudget's own '(whole response)' branch). At budget_kb=8 and at default (40KB) the trim_report stays intact and accurately names the real tool + a working recovery hint, so this defect is a function of trim PRESSURE, not a universal kala_story_get bug.
